quotes.quote: By my own count the 15th or 16th reset in a few months.
Honestly, the AI isn't as clever as I'd hoped, and it's naturally cautious.
I feel full, and the scale isn't moving as fast as I'd like — I usually lose faster nearer 300.
I feel more content overall. My head's clearer and I have a routine. For once it's less Sunday scaries and more just appreciating the evening.
None of the coaches has really changed what I do.
